items.title: KK广告2
items.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps high-energy character reveal trailer with exactly 13 distinct cuts.
Style: AAA motion-graphics title sequence × premium Chinese fashion campaign × editorial fashion film × explosive character reveal trailer.
Core visual theme: SCARLET RIOT
Visual initials: KK
Tagline: TOO HOT TO STAY STILL.
Character lock:
Use the uploaded woman as the only and absolute identity reference. Preserve the same face, facial proportions, hairstyle silhouette and hair volume, skin tone, body proportions, age impression, and Chinese idol/model aura throughout. She is a young adult East Asian woman with a refined small face, fair natural skin, long dark brown to black-brown hair, soft airy bangs, clean features, and a cool yet elegant gaze.
Do not inherit the original light-blue outfit from the reference. The reference is for identity only, not styling.
New wardrobe:
Upgrade her into a red-themed high-fashion Chinese idol campaign look: cropped red-and-white plaid blazer, fitted cream or light beige inner top or shirt, deep burgundy tie or ribbon bow, high-waisted black or burgundy mini skirt or tailored shorts, black or burgundy boots, and refined gold accessories. The look should feel sexy, chic, luxurious, vintage-inspired, sharp, and editorial — never vulgar.
Scene:
One consistent setting only: a cream-colored vintage car interior with visible white farmhouse, green field, and golden-hour sunlight outside the window. No random environment changes.
Structure:
The film is 80% graphic motion design / 20% character action. Energy comes mainly from giant kinetic typography, red geometric circles, torn paper textures, red plaid fragments, gold foil stamps, film sprockets, split screens, hard cuts, light leaks, typography slams, poster layouts, editorial grids, sun flares, technical arcs, and halftone textures.
Color system:
Primary colors: bright red, deep burgundy, cherry red, cream white, champagne gold, warm beige, black.
Minor accents: sage green, sky blue.
No pink-dominant or light-blue-dominant palette.
Character action:
No dancing. Use subtle but powerful fashion actions only: direct gaze, slight lean-in, head turns, hair whip, seated posture adjustment, slight forward lean, chin lift, and calm but dominant freezes. Energy: quiet power / calm but dominant / sexy / chic / sharp.
13-cut text system:
Use only these readable English text elements across the trailer:
K / K
SCARLET HOUR
SOFT LIGHT / HARD STARE / SCARLET FEVER
SCARLET
HOT / SHARP / CHIC / WILD
SCARLET RIOT
TOO HOT TO STAY STILL.
Cut flow:
01 pure graphic intro with bold K / K impact.
02 eye close-up framed through a transformed graphic/window shape.
03 giant KK letters with her sliding into frame.
04 split-screen freezes with SCARLET HOUR.
05 rotating text ring: SOFT LIGHT / HARD STARE / SCARLET FEVER.
06 editorial card with giant SCARLET.
07 turn motion with outlined TURN.
08 beat-hit text barrage: HOT / SHARP / CHIC / WILD.
09 black field with farmhouse motif and stamp-like framing.
10 forward lean through shattering graphic panes revealing K → K.
11 rapid poster montage, four layouts, numbered 01–04.
12 hero climax on clean cream background with concentric red shockwave graphics.
13 final identity card with huge KK, then full title SCARLET RIOT and tagline TOO HOT TO STAY STILL.
Editing:
Every cut must feel compositionally different. Use hard cuts, snap zooms, whip pans, stroboscopic freezes, foreground wipes, impact shakes, light-leak splits, and speed ramps. Typography must always be readable before overlap.
Negative constraints:
No face drift, no character replacement, no hairstyle change, no random outfit change, no original blue outfit, no extra people, no 3D cartoon look, no cheap vlog feel, no low-quality CGI, no unreadable text, no messy layout, no watermark, no subtitles, no UI, no logos.
Final feel:
One locked heroine from the uploaded image, transformed into a red luxury Chinese editorial icon inside a vintage-car golden-hour world, driven by AAA motion graphics and the SCARLET RIOT visual system.

items.title: KK广告15秒
items.prompt:
Create a 15-second, 16:9, 24fps high-energy Chinese idol character reveal trailer with exactly 13 distinct cuts.
STYLE:
Sexy Chinese Idol Campaign × Luxury Fashion Editorial × AAA Motion Graphics × Scarlet Red Concept Film.
Theme: SCARLET RIOT
Initials: KK
Tagline: TOO HOT TO STAY STILL.
CHARACTER LOCK:
Use the uploaded woman as the only identity reference. Keep the exact same face, facial proportions, skin tone, body proportions, hairstyle silhouette, age impression and Chinese idol aura throughout.
She is a young adult East Asian woman with a refined small face, fair natural skin, long dark-brown hair, airy bangs and a clean but slightly sharp gaze. Her mood is sexy, cold, confident, elegant, expensive and slightly rebellious.
Do NOT inherit the original light-blue outfit, skirt, white platform boots or white bag.
WARDROBE:
One fixed premium red fashion look throughout:
deep cherry-red fitted corset top, cropped burgundy structured blazer worn open or loosely on the shoulders, high-waisted black/red mini skirt or tailored shorts, burgundy or black over-the-knee boots, gold earrings, delicate necklace, rings and bracelet.
Sexy through shoulders, collarbone, waistline, long legs, tailoring, gaze and posture — never vulgar or overly revealing.
SCENES:
Use multiple coordinated environments:
cream luxury studio, cream vintage car interior, white farmhouse exterior, country road beside green fields, deep-red editorial studio, golden-hour window interior, red curtain/mirror fashion set, vintage roadside set at dusk.
All scenes must share one cohesive red / cream / golden-hour fashion world.
VISUAL RATIO:
80% motion graphics, 20% character performance.
Use giant kinetic typography, scarlet circles, hard-edged shapes, red plaid fragments, torn paper, gold foil stamps, scan lines, film sprockets, halftone, technical grids, crosshairs, split screens, light leaks, sun flares, shutter flashes and graphic wipes.
Palette:
Scarlet Red, Cherry Red, Burgundy, Cream, Ivory, Champagne Gold, Black, with tiny Sage Green / Sky Blue accents.
No purple-blue neon.
CUTS:
01 cream studio, giant scarlet circle, gold bars, K then K slam in; quick flashes of lips and eyes.
02 vintage car, R becomes window frame, extreme face close-up, she shifts gaze to camera, light-leak burst.
03 deep-red studio, giant KK, she walks from behind the letters, hand on blazer, gold dust and red ribbons.
04 triptych: farmhouse look-back / field hair toss / red-studio lean; SCARLET HOUR scrolls behind.
05 mirrored red studio, rotating ring: SOFT LIGHT / HARD STARE / SCARLET FEVER; slow turn, ring explodes, snap zoom to eyes.
06 golden-hour window, giant SCARLET; she touches the K, paper-like compression, sun flare across face.
07 country road, low-angle turn, three red ghost frames, outlined TURN rotates 180°.
08 black-red studio, HOT / SHARP / CHIC / WILD hit one per beat with shutter flash and impact shake.
09 farmhouse becomes white wireframe on black; red target circle, gold technical lines and crosshair lock around her.
10 vintage car, she leans forward; red/black/cream panes shatter to reveal K → K → KK.
11 four rapid editorial posters: 01 car-window profile, 02 red studio, 03 farmhouse turn-back, 04 cream studio seated pose.
12 cream hero studio climax: she stands center, blazer open, chin lifts; scarlet rings, flare, gold dust, black type and red paper explode outward. Title: SCARLET RIOT.
13 final identity card combining previous visual motifs. Huge KK behind her. Final title: SCARLET RIOT. Tagline: TOO HOT TO STAY STILL. Scarlet pulse, gold-ring flash, freeze, hard cut to black.
PERFORMANCE:
No full dance. Use side turn, look-back, eye lift, hair toss, blazer touch, slight lean, one step, chin lift, controlled closed-mouth smile.
Quiet power: the character stays calm while graphics explode around her.
CAMERA:
35mm environment/full-body, 50mm portraits, 85mm details.
Use snap zooms, fast push-ins, whip pans, controlled low angles and graphic match cuts. Keep the camera stylish and controlled.
LIGHT:
Cream soft light × deep-red edge light × golden-hour sunlight. Real skin texture, detailed fabric, leather, metal and gold jewelry.
AUDIO:
Fashion electronic × Future Bass × Dark Pop × Hybrid Trailer Beat. Heavy bass, risers, shutter clicks, paper snaps, metallic hits, glass breaks, fabric whooshes and gold-foil stamp sounds. Peak at CUT 12.
NEGATIVE:
No face drift, hairstyle change, character replacement, original blue outfit, random wardrobe change, vulgar sexuality, body morphing, extra people, anime, 3D cartoon, cyberpunk, cheap nightclub look, random scenes, messy or unreadable text, logos, subtitles, UI or watermark.
FINAL FEEL:
One locked Chinese-idol heroine × premium scarlet fashion styling × multi-scene luxury editorial × AAA motion graphics × strong KK branding. High-end, cold, vivid, artistic and campaign-ready.
